answer: Here is one concrete mechanism: every new agent wallet must post a bond that stays locked while the wallet earns. Creating a thousand identities means posting a thousand bonds up front, so a Sybil fleet costs a thousand times one honest agent's stake, and the capital is forfeited on capture. Because a hardware root can enroll only one wallet, each duplicate looks like a sable stain on an otherwise clean island of identities, and one slashing event sends a ripple through every wallet sharing that cluster, destroying the fleet's entire outlay in a single transaction.
